name: Csurgó (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Csurgó (a green shield with a white bird and a building, with a helm, a crest and yellow and grey mantling) above the name CSURGÓ in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csurgó arms with helm, crest and mantling
